Author: Sadonia
Name: Eorzea Milkers
Punchline: (Work in progress) An 18+ dairy life game: be the cow, the farmer or the owner, and run a dairy with friends.
Description:
WORK IN PROGRESS: Eorzea Milkers is still growing. Expect balance changes and new features in updates.

Eorzea Milkers is a dairy life game you play with friends. Be a cow, a farmer, the owner of your own dairy, or any mix.

- Cows make milk while they play. Eat, drink, rest and have treats for faster milk, then get milked at a stall or by a farmer's hand
- You're paid the moment you're milked, by your grade (C up to S+). Higher grades also milk faster and give more milk
- Farmers hand milk, groom cows, clean stalls, fill jugs from the dairy tank and bake butter and cookies for the dairy shelf
- Deliver milk to customer orders, other dairies' buy orders and the Grand Creamery's weekly contract
- Set up your dairy anywhere, with a private place at home for members, stalls to upgrade and a shared fund
- Levels to 100 for every role, daily goals, awards, and dairies that level up together

The Bull role is coming in a later update.

Adults only (18+); Lalafell characters can't play. Nothing is ever said in public chat, and it never moves your character. Lifestream is optional, for one-click travel to public dairies.
